params.body:
Closes #1012

## What was wrong

`ProcessVehiclePhoto` writes three sizes of an uploaded photo to the bucket. A write the bucket does not take is asked again after one second, and a second refusal throws `StorageUnavailable` so the queue can try the job again with the tmp file still in place. Two things made that noisier and weaker than it should be:

- The job had no backoff, so the queue's next attempt ran at once against a bucket that had just refused twice.
- Every failed attempt reached Nightwatch as an unhandled exception, also when a later attempt wrote the photo. Nightwatch #65 (2026-10-13, `23482/car_image_1.jpg`) and #77 (2026-11-21, `24107/thumb_car_image_6.jpeg`, seen from 10:42 to 10:48) are both this alarm.

## What changes

- `ProcessVehiclePhoto::handle()` catches `StorageUnavailable` while attempts remain and releases the job without an exception: 10 seconds before the second attempt, 60 before the third.
- Only the last attempt throws. `failed()` then removes the row as before (R S1-6.36), so an alarm in Nightwatch now means a photo that did not arrive, and the dealer sees it is gone and uploads it again.
- The job declares `$tries = 3`, the same as the production worker (`--tries=3`), so it can tell the last attempt from the others.
- Rule R S1-6.36 describes the later attempts.

## Not in this change

The message still says only "the bucket did not accept the write": the disk answers false and the bucket's own reason (a timeout, a 503) is lost. `VehicleApiService::writePhoto` writes through the Flysystem driver to keep that reason; doing the same here would tell the next alarm apart. Left out to keep this change to the retry behaviour.

Whether the photo of #77 arrived in the end was not checked: that needs the failed-job count on production.

## Tests

- `test_on_the_queue_a_refused_write_is_asked_again_later_and_only_the_last_attempt_throws` in `ASlowBucketIsNotAMissingPhotoTest`: release after 10 s and 60 s without an exception, the third attempt throws and the row goes, and a write taken on a later attempt lands the photo.
- Full suite: 3298 tests green.

Source: Portal mail:18 and mail:63 (forwarded Nightwatch notifications).
params.title: Photo upload: a refused bucket write waits for a later attempt, only the last one is an alarm
